item.title: Fintech Startup Zeta Pay Raises $20 Mn In Series B Led By Northstar Ventures
item.description: Bengaluru-based Zeta Pay, which builds lending infrastructure for small merchants, has raised $20 Mn in its Series B round led by Northstar Ventures, with participation from Blue Peak Capital.

item.title: Exclusive: Orbit Health Acquires AI Diagnostics Startup Lumen Labs
item.description: Healthtech unicorn Orbit Health has acquired Pune-based AI diagnostics startup Lumen Labs in a cash and stock deal.

item.title: Kirana Tech Startup ShelfWise Opens New Office In Hyderabad, To Hire 150
item.description: ShelfWise said the new office will house engineering and data science teams and that it plans to hire 150 people over the next year.

item.title: Edtech Startup Learnly Lays Off 120 Employees Amid Restructuring
item.description: Learnly has laid off around 120 employees across sales and content teams as it restructures to reach profitability.

item.title: Govt Notifies Amendments To Consumer Protection Rules For Ecommerce
item.description: The amendments cover disclosure requirements for online marketplaces.
